newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: TAP pilots may end protest tomorrow.
newsitem.headline: TAP pilots may end protest tomorrow.

text.p: Pilots of state airline TAP-Air Portugal could end a dispute with management over working hours at a meeting on Wednesday, their union said in a statement.

"There is a conviction within the Union of Civil Aviation Pilots (SPAC) that conditions exist for TAP and SPAC at their meeting tomorrow to reach an understanding that would allow the dispute over overtime and holidays to be suspended," it said.
The pilots began a protest on March 15 in which they declined to work overtime or during holiday periods.
SPAC, which represents all of TAP's 430 pilots, said it had set a deadline of May 31 for the talks to be resolved, otherwise it could call a strike.

A general meeting of SPAC "conferred powers on the leadership to declare a strike encompassing whatever flights or periods it sees fit, if TAP infringes any commitments it has made," the statement said.
